crypto/key_format#

Keys in PEM files: PKCS#8 PRIVATE KEY and SubjectPublicKeyInfo PUBLIC KEY.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let parsed = ParsedPrivateKey(pem_text);
parsed.algorithm();                          // KeyAlgorithm.ed25519, …
let key = parsed.signing_key();
let pem = PublicKeyPem(ParsedPublicKey(public_pem).verifying_key()).string();

Description#

Keys in PEM files: PKCS#8 PRIVATE KEY and SubjectPublicKeyInfo PUBLIC KEY.

Ed25519, ECDSA P-256 and P-384 and RSA keys are read; others are KeyAlgorithm.other.
